documents_expected.why: call page: round status and process
the two stages and the five stage-2 documents

eligibility.rule: Non-profit organisations, anywhere except the USA and Canada
eligibility.quote: Non-profit organisations can apply to EOCA for grants of up to €30,000, to implement a conservation project of up to two years in duration in any country around the world except the USA and Canada

eligibility.rule: Protects a threatened species or habitat, reconnects people with nature and includes hands-on work
eligibility.quote: Project applications MUST: - protect a threatened species or habitat; - reconnect people with nature; AND - involve hands-on practical conservation work.
Projects MUST include practical hands-on work, such as habitat restoration, removal of invasive species, anti-poaching measures, etc.
All applications MUST be completed in English.
alt_quotes: all applications must please be written in English.

eligibility.rule: Projects of up to two years
eligibility.quote: We are looking for projects up to TWO years in length.

documents.quote: The 1st stage is a short application form.

documents.item: Proof of registered non-profit status (with translation)
documents.quote: A copy of some documentation that proves your organisation is registered, non-profit.
At least TWO references / letters of recommendation from an organisation that has provided funding to you in the past and you would not mind us contacting, if your project is shortlisted.
Project Timeline / Logframe - A single page spreadsheet that gives an overview of the activities taking place, and when, during your project.
Predicted Project Impact table - this form will be available alongside the application form.

documents.item: Budget in euros showing other funding
documents.quote: A budget for the amount you have applied for in Euros (€): how exactly will the funds be used?

effort.quote: This will be available on our website to download, complete and email back to us - this is the only document that must be submitted at this stage.
If this application is successful, we will email you the 2nd stage, full application form to complete.

effort.step: Shortlisted projects mobilise supporters for a public vote
effort.quote: The public vote involves some effort on the part of the projects involved, to mobilise supporters and generate votes for their project over a two week period.

after_award.quote: EOCA typically funds projects in three stages: 50% first payment, 30% approximately half way through and only after an interim report and financial statement has been submitted and accepted, and the final 20% after project completion and acceptance of the final report and financial statement.

notes: 2026 round closed; the next round is March 2027 with no date, so no due date. Up to €30,000. The budget must show other funding, but match isn't stated as required. Gather-2 spent three of its eight slots on member-only PDFs and left the example questions (PDF and Word) unread.
